title: AI summary missing and 8 seconds of silence
scenario: Since 14:00 one call in five reaches the analyst without the Bedrock-generated summary, after 8 seconds of silence. The summary Lambda reports zero errors and zero throttles; L2 wants more memory. You get flow logs, Lambda logs, X-Ray style timelines, Lambda and Bedrock metrics and the function config.
task: Explain why Connect takes the error branch while the Lambda reports success
Tie the start time to Bedrock throttling and the SDK retry/backoff chain; rule out memory
Add a deadline from the flow budget and remaining time, degraded answers, bounded retries, short output
Set the function timeout to Connect's sync limit; discuss async Lambda mode
acceptance: Real SDK retry middleware through a fake HTTP handler: every scenario answers inside the budget
No exceptions to Connect; flat string map with summaryStatus and degradedReason
maxTokens <= 400, empty transcript skips Bedrock, Timeout <= 8 s
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md
